strategies.text:
Estimated Time to Win: [277.5s - 295s]

Overview:

This is a challenging solo which focuses on, maximizing energy gained on Necrozma Dawn Wings by absorbing charge attacks and well timed rejoins while minorly using Mega Gengar as a leadoff and Executor.

Battle Party:

Mega Gengar has 2 roles occurring at the start and optionally the end of the fight

  1. Leadoff: Use Mega Gengar's Shadow Ball to quickly make Azelf aggressive. This is because Mega Gengar can quickly dish out 200 damage with a standard 6 lick + shadow ball combo thus fueling Azelf with 100 energy within ~6s. As a result, Azelf may begin casting charge moves sooner for NDW to absorb. When a heavy charge move occurs, Future Sight or Fire Blast, switch to NDW.
  2. Executor: Mega Gengar can optionally be swapped in to deal a fast knock out blow with shadow ball. This would otherwise outspeed the slower Moongeist Beam.

Necrozma Dawn Wings will contribute the majority of the DPS.

  1. Each NDW casts 2-3 Moongeist Beams
  2. It can comfortably tank: 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts.
  3. Once the active NDW is too low to cast another Moongeist Beam, swap to the next one.

DPS Tips:

Tick Perfect Cast [TPC]:

  1. While not required, it is extremely helpful to time each Moongeist beam, especially if running the high energy focused Psycho Cut.
  2. In order to TPC, simply slow down your taps as energy nears 100. Wait a brief moment after the 2nd to last tap and then cast Moongeist Beam. If this strategy isn't preferred, Shadow Claw may be the better option. Time Save: ~10-15s

Substitute [Sub]:

  1. Against Future Sight, Mega Gengar is in danger of being 1 shot when playing in the first slot after the first rejoin. Creating a second battle party (with the same pokemon) where Necrozma Dawn Wings is in the first spot helps overcome this issue. Time Save: Varies

Estimated Time to Win: [264s - 288s]

Time to win varies from 264s to 288s based on:

  1. Size of battle party (Stays the same after 4 NDW are used)
  2. Latency
  3. Level of execution
  4. Level of counters
